label: a network name joined to the number by a hyphen does not hide it
a day and a month before the number, and a word glued to it, hide nothing
a unit word after the last group does not take that group for an amount
an expiry as a month name before the number hides neither
a claim that card data was removed or not stored is true (judge 'dn-expiry-name-claim' + store scan)
